def verify_allocation():
    bits_count = {}
    for key, (_, bits) in HIRES_MCKP_ALLOCATION.items():
        bits_count[bits] = bits_count.get(bits, 0) + 1
    assert len(HIRES_MCKP_ALLOCATION) == 112, f"Expected 112 heads, got {len(HIRES_MCKP_ALLOCATION)}"
    assert bits_count == {8: 4, 2: 8, 4: 100}, f"Unexpected distribution: {bits_count}"
    eight_bit = [k for k, (_, b) in HIRES_MCKP_ALLOCATION.items() if b == 8]
    two_bit = [k for k, (_, b) in HIRES_MCKP_ALLOCATION.items() if b == 2]
    print(f"Allocation verified: {bits_count}")
    print(f"  8-bit heads: {eight_bit}")
    print(f"  2-bit heads: {two_bit}")

    orig = patch_attention(model, HIRES_MCKP_ALLOCATION)

    restore_attention(model, orig)
    t2e = time.time() - t2
    print(f">>> mckp_ppl = {mckp_ppl:.4f} (old: {OLD_CONSTRAINED}, took {t2e:.1f}s)")

    # Task 3: Uniform 4-bit
    uniform_alloc = {}
    for layer in range(28):
        for head in range(4):
            uniform_alloc[f"{layer},{head}"] = ("quant", 4)

    print(f"\n=== [3/3] Uniform 4-bit PPL ===")
    t3 = time.time()
    orig = patch_attention(model, uniform_alloc)
    uniform_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, DEVICE, stride=STRIDE)

    print(f">>> uniform_4bit_ppl = {uniform_ppl:.4f} (old fp16: {OLD_UNIFORM_4BIT_FP16}, took {t3e:.1f}s)")

    total_time = time.time() - t0

    print(f"=== Hires MCKP Re-evaluation (current eval_ppl.py) ===")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Baseline bf16 PPL:         {baseline_ppl:.4f}  (old: {OLD_BASELINE})")
    print(f"Constrained MCKP bf16 PPL: {mckp_ppl:.4f}  (old: {OLD_CONSTRAINED})")
    print(f"Uniform 4-bit bf16 PPL:    {uniform_ppl:.4f}  (old fp16: {OLD_UNIFORM_4BIT_FP16})")
    print(f"Delta (MCKP vs baseline):  {mckp_ppl - baseline_ppl:.4f}")
    print(f"Delta (MCKP vs uniform):   {mckp_ppl - uniform_ppl:.4f}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Total time: {total_time:.1f}s")

    results = {
        "experiment": "hires_mckp_reeval",
        "model": "Qwen2.5-7B",
        "dtype": "bfloat16",
        "stride": STRIDE,
        "device": DEVICE,
        "baseline_ppl_bf16": round(baseline_ppl, 4),
        "mckp_ppl_bf16": round(mckp_ppl, 4),
        "uniform_4bit_ppl_bf16": round(uniform_ppl, 4),
        "delta_mckp_vs_baseline": round(mckp_ppl - baseline_ppl, 4),

        "old_baseline_ppl": OLD_BASELINE,

        "budget": 0.25,
        "elapsed_seconds": round(total_time, 1),
    }

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {OUTPUT_FILE}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
